doc.title: Donn Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 6, 2009

title: Closing
summary: Thanks and goodbyes before the evening gig.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well it’s been fascinating talking to you.
I know we’ve both got class dinners to get to.
I hope you have a good gig tonight. You guys always seem to rise to the occasion.
I think we’ll have fun and it’ll be another good time. And I want to thank you for your time.
And maybe we’ll see you later?
